purpose: Reduce preventable companion-animal suffering and unmanaged stray recruitment by identifying bad-state transitions early, repairing service/access gaps, and maximizing stable welfare-positive integration with human communities.

causal_status.context: May prioritize investigation; cannot establish an individual cause.
causal_status.established: Direct enough evidence to use the driver for bounded operational reasoning.

human_transfer_boundary: Only abstract evidence/transition/access/intervention/evaluation machinery may generalize. Human applications require a separate rights, autonomy, entitlement, consent, anti-discrimination, due-process and dignity constitution.
notes: Ordinary companionship, sanctuary, managed community care, reunification and specialist roles can all be successful outcomes depending on the individual animal.
Specialist work is a tiny optional pathway and never a population-management strategy.

The preferred structural sequence is: prevent transition -> repair existing-service access -> smallest case intervention -> existing-service extension -> reversible pilot -> permanent infrastructure only after sustained evidence.
Animal welfare is a systems-method testbed for public-good agency, not a proxy population for human social-policy experiments.
